note: Groups provisioning findings that reviewers filed under four names (api-version-validation, public-constant-definitions, retained-api-version-constants, legacy-api-version-constants) when the code is a resource's public list of supported API versions (ResourceVersions constants). Nothing is validated, so they move to one pattern. Selected mechanically by subtype/explanation mentioning a version, November 2, 2026; applied when the dashboard is published with review records unchanged.

patterns.name: Resource API-version constants
patterns.description: Handwritten public constants listing the API versions a provisioning resource supports, usually kept so older versions stay selectable after regeneration.
